about_the_game:
Zereoton Hauntings is a 2D top-down survival horror game based on the story of a paranormal enthusiast called Mateo who loves to investigate the various haunted locations in the US.

Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, went to an abandoned haunted house, located in a secluded area near the dense forest of Ohio, to experience the paranormal. This abandoned location has a dark past, with many reported to have died here. During the 1700s, this house was actually a functioning hospital where lots of patients died because of unknown illnesses. It was later transformed into a family home and was sold to a wealthy family. But it was said that the family couldn't live there even for a month and left the house, leaving behind their belongings in a hurry. It is also said that there is an alien dark creature called Zereoton that is responsible for such a level of paranormal activities.

Mateo, when exploring the house, could feel as if someone was following him, but he couldn't see it. Whatever it was, it seemed to follow him to whichever room he went to.

You play as Mateo, the paranormal enthusiast, and will you be able to escape the haunted, abandoned location without getting a scratch?

Are you ready to accept the challenge?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire abandoned haunted house!
  • Come face to face with evil entities!
  • Collect items like keys, sealed letter etc.
  • Avoid traps like spikes, rotating blades etc.
  • Explore spirit world!
  • Nearly half an hour of paranormal investigation!

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

  • Processor: Dual Core 1 Ghz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 128 MB of Video Memory
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
